regions.region: upper-left Graphic Abstract arrow and one-sentence caption

Generic R1/R2/E and [Pd] are not a unique experiment, so this page is linked to the existing Scheme 1C general-scheme record rather than used to fabricate a run or yield.

The generic drawing does not verify any machine structure encoding.
